Ghost at the Cemetery Update

Another Cat and Mouse Adventure

13 November 2026 — in blog

Finally, after several years, book 2 in the Cat and Mouse Adventure is coming together.

The first version was scrapped. I didn’t like it at all! The second version has been written in full and the first full edit completed this morning. I am so happy.

At this rate, a release date in the first half of 2027 is definitely on the horizon. That timeframe will be narrowed down when I’m certain I can deliver.

And I’ve already got themes and possibilities rolling around my head for Book 3.

Stay tuned for more details soon.
